lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: A 37-year-old man was beaten up by a mob in Uttar Pradesh because of his man boobs, according to Kenny Sebastian.

lines.speaker: Kenny Sebastian
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, because they were disappointed. You laughed. You laughed, bro.

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: No, that is the wrong answer, Kenny. This is not an applause break. My hands were like, this is also part of the show, Jose.

lines.speaker: Jose Covaco
lines.text: I'll try. I'm not very good at this. Was he beaten up before because he refused to take part in gang violence?

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: That's a good attempt. That's a good attempt, but that's the wrong answer. All of you guys have given the wrong answers. No more options on this one, unfortunately. The real reason of this incident: a man was beaten to death in a train after a dispute over a seat.
